title: Grandmother and Children in Backyard Garden, 1952 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white family snapshot taken on August 10, 1952, showing a smiling older woman bent over beside two young children in a sunny backyard. In the background, a blooming garden and wooden outbuilding/shed stand against leafy trees. The print features classic scalloped deckle edges characteristic of 1950s amateur snapshots.
